description: A diagnosis that was accepted and stored.

run_id.description: The run the diagnosis is for.

accepted.description: Always true: a diagnosis that is refused is a failure and has no result.

submission.description: The submission file, as an absolute path. It holds the normalized diagnosis: paths cleaned and path:N split into a path and a line.

rejected_path_calls.description: How many refused submit calls of the run cited a path that is no file of the repository. It is counted from rejections.jsonl, and never decides a landing.
